title: Vibeflow API v1 contract source (Phase 2)
description: Single source of truth for the /api/v1 contract, derived from the local surface per plan api-v1-unification.md §1.1/§1.2. The OpenAPI document (docs/api/openapi.yaml + docs/api/openapi.json), the generated route registry (packages/api-core/src/route-registry.gen.ts) and the served spec embed (packages/cli/src/server/openapi.gen.ts) are all generated from THIS file by packages/api-core/scripts/gen-api-artifacts.mjs — never hand-edited. Plan section references below are to docs/plans/api-v1-unification.md in the private repo.

openapi.title: Vibeflow API v1
openapi.description: Unified local + cloud task API. Locally the Phase 1 read alias (/api/v1, GET only) delegates to the local handler in localPath, and GET /api/docs renders this document.

conventions.statusNote: D6 resolution: v1 speaks the local hyphenated set on write; 'cancelled' is an accepted v1 value passed through on read, never lossily read-mapped to 'done' (plan §1.3). Local never emits 'cancelled'; the normalizer accepts it so the same battery runs against both surfaces.
conventions.commentAuthorNote: Ledger L1 resolution: a comment carries an explicit author field ('user' | 'agent'); the token-driven actor question is decided as author-preserved — the normalizer MUST NOT strip or rewrite 'author', and a manifest case asserts the written author reads back verbatim.
conventions.externalIdNote: D3 (still OPEN on namespace choice): v1 task responses carry BOTH 'id' and 'externalId'. Locally they are equal (the local id IS the universal external id). Resolution order cli_id-first + 409 AMBIGUOUS_TASK_ID is a cloud-adapter rule (Phase 3); the Phase 0 assertion is presence + equality on the local surface.
conventions.pagination: Every collection endpoint is cursor-paginated (?limit=&cursor=) returning { items, nextCursor }. No cursor exists on either side today; the contract fixes it before freeze (plan §1.3). Phase 0 local reads still return the legacy envelope — the manifest records the delta per operation.

operations.summary: List personal access tokens (prefix only, never secrets)
operations.notes: Plan §4.5 account endpoint (not a §1.2 task-surface row, hence planRow 0): cloud-only, no local handler — token management is online-only. Returns rows with prefix, name, scopes, lastUsedAt, expiresAt, revokedAt.

operations.summary: Create a personal access token (secret returned once)
operations.notes: Plan §4.5: {name, scopes, expiresAt?} returns the plaintext vbf_pat_ secret exactly once, plus the prefix-only row. Session-authenticated for bootstrap, or bearer with tokens:manage.

operations.summary: Revoke a personal access token (soft revoke, audit trail kept)
operations.notes: Plan §4.5/H1: sets revoked_at; api_tokens is the single authority so revocation is structurally authoritative — no fallback path can authenticate the string.
